mechanism.does: replaces every library control with a hand-rolled token-driven equivalent, rebuilds the application shell around one measured alignment grid, then proves completion by measurement rather than by build success: a grep sweep across source, end-to-end specs and shipped documentation, browser-read geometry and composed colours for every overlay and every pair of edges that must align, and an automated accessibility audit over every route
mechanism.returns: an app with the library uninstalled, a reusable class vocabulary in one stylesheet, zero accessibility violations, and a handoff document plus a verification script that repeat the migration on sibling apps

mechanism.takes: an existing browser-driven test suite that only clicks through the happy path, plus the running application and its data service
mechanism.does: adds the techniques a team actually needs in production suites - intercepting and faking server responses so failure and empty states can be tested without a server, asserting on the requests the app sends and proving that a cancelled action sends none, driving the screen from the keyboard rather than by scripted value-setting, grouping a test into named reported steps with assertions that collect every failure instead of stopping at the first, and checking the backend directly after a screen action - then proves the whole suite green on ports isolated from every other service on the machine
mechanism.returns: a suite that covers error paths and backend state as well as the happy path, a written guide explaining each technique, and a reusable script that runs any such suite in isolation and restores every file it touched

portsAsIs: the five test techniques and their worked examples

mechanism.takes: a set of sibling applications built from one template, all still on a component library, plus one of them already migrated to the target look as the reference
mechanism.does: separates the part of each application that is identical across all of them from the part that is genuinely per-application, copies the first verbatim from the reference by script so it is exact and free, and spends parallel agents only on the second; then rebuilds and re-runs every suite per application, checks each one in a real browser because a passing build and a green suite both miss duplicated or clipped regions, and takes the cases where the library being removed is the subject being taught back to the owner as a scope decision rather than deciding them silently
mechanism.returns: every application on the same design system and the same shell, all builds clean and all suites green, one dependency deliberately retained where a genuine peer requirement exists, related demos consolidated into the module that owns the topic, and the course overview corrected against what is actually on disk
